comments.author: Azure
comments.body_html:
Have you ever read the books? Crysis: Legion and Crysis Escalation? Or watching Alpha version of Crysis 2?

There are so much to Nanosuit that the vanilla games, especially the later series can’t do justice. The ability to customize just how much energy you pour into cloaking or armor mode for example. So much you can either just appear faintly invisible with your shadow is still appearing to complete invisibility without any trace like in the actual game, but this is very energy consuming:

*I check my levels: Cloak’s fully charged. Twenty seconds guaranteed invisibility to beetles and choppers, forty if I don’t have to do anything fancy. And out there, all those cobalt-eyed cocksuckers just waiting for me to make a move … Crysis: Legion, PRISM

The charge bar tops up at six. I fade, roll away from the planter, get to my feet. I’ve noticed that the cloak lasts a lot longer when the suit isn’t pulling power for a lot of other things. I can stay invisible for forty-five seconds, maybe a whole minute if I just stand still. Maybe almost as long if I just move very, very … slowly

- Crysis: Legion, CRASH*

Meanwhile the Alpha version of Crysis 2 as shown in here (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_WGrL9jyCHA&ab_channel=Dorian)

It basically got the idea of “Passive” and “Active” submode for each 4 modes. Yes they used to make it closer to the first game and warhead, before just streamlining it into 2 mode. But I found your version of having 3 modes; Power, Cloak, Armor is interesting.

I think I might have idea of how passive cloaking works. It might simply give user chameleon-like camouflage blending. But not fade entirely. It migth cost some part of energy but it’s not draining the battery every second. Perhaps as suggested in here:

“I figure now might be a good time to try out the N2’s cloaking option. I sacc’ the icon and watch my hands melt away into the background. Not just my hands. Not just me. The shotgun I just scavenged melts away as well. It takes a moment for that to sink in. I haven’t worn a cloak since Annapolis but I know the tech: fast-fractal pattern-matching, Bayesian wraparounds. Same basic thing an octopus does when it wants to blend in. But this Jackal doesn’t pack a cloak, and neither do the ammo and supply clips I’ve scrounged, and all of that’s just turned clearer than glass.”

- Crysis Legion It could be in theory make stealth incredibly diverse mechanic, you can be basically akin to ghillied up sniper that can’t be spotted from distance but only very close. Or completely invisible.

Other feats:
- The ability to intercept all radio chatter in certain area as wide as hundreds of miles radius
- Makes you smart and charismatic, and ambixdexterous (dual wielding anyone?)
- Ability to convert human corpses(!) into more energy and building block, nanotech BS essentially. The tech is amusing enough, it is called as NOM:

And what fuels this unmatched combination of power and protection? Virtually anything. While the N2’s primary coupling is compatible with any BVN-series hydrogen cell, the suit also acquires and stores energy automatically from a wide range of ambient sources: kinetic motion, passive solar/thermal, and atmospheric microwave to name but a few. The standard-issue universal adapter allows recharging from virtually any hardline electrical source, domestic or military—and with CryNet’s optional Necro-Organic Metabolites plug-in (NOM), the N2 can even extract usable energy from battlefield carrion!

- That is achieved by needle like protrusion in Nanosuit finger, in theory it can be used to recycle scrap metal and junk into useful item with the precision of nanoscale.
- Basically bullet time mode. To give you idea, look at the intro of Crysis 2:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P6W_FcUpOig&t=50s

at 0:50, you can see how Alcatraz perceive the Helicopter rotor as slowed down, when in real time it’s should be spinning super fast. I don’t have the number but that should give some image how nanosuit super reflex can works.

I dunno if all those features can be added, maybe one day hahaha. I just love that I don’t have to wait for Crysis 4 to get my immersive gameplay + Nanosuit

comments.author: Pettan
comments.body_html:
Azure

Thats alot of features.

1. The AI in this game will perceive you regardless of how transparent you are either way. What you are asking for is probably going to require altering the time to detect/perceive for the AI. Which would probably clash with other AI altering mods and also require another client mod entry, which would probably break anytime BSG messes with client backend (which is why client mods break alot).

2. For the energy system, it can be achieved by having a way to consume/destroy/recycle items ingame, probably with a tool in the inventory, and lets be real. Its such a niche use and complicates things because you have to now write a huge new table for every item in the game to determine how much is recycled.
